description: Configuration class for setting up dedicated JPA data source, entity manager, transaction manager, and JDBC template for event-related database operations in the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: DedicatedEventsJpaDaoConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class for dedicated JPA data source, entity manager, transaction manager, and JDBC template for event-related database operations.

methods.name: eventsDataSourceProperties
methods.description: Creates and configures DataSourceProperties for the events data source.

methods.name: eventsDataSource
methods.description: Initializes the HikariDataSource for events using properties.

methods.name: eventsEntityManagerFactory
methods.description: Builds the EntityManagerFactory for event entities.

methods.name: eventsTransactionManager
methods.description: Creates JpaTransactionManager for event entity transactions.

methods.name: eventsJdbcTemplate
methods.description: Creates JdbcTemplate for executing SQL queries on the events data source.
